role: The village's iron golem: patrols its village, attacks hostile mobs on sight (its own attackEntityAsMob, 7+rand(15) damage), holds a rose for villagers it healed, drops iron ingots and poppies.

members.name: EntityIronGolem
members.note: size 1.4x2.9, avoids water, then ai_setup_kind's VK_IRON_GOLEM task list (EntityAIGoLookAtPos, defend village, look at villager, attack on collide)

members.name: isAIEnabled
members.note: the boolean is folded into the ai_setup_kind task structure

members.name: updateAITick
members.note: the 400-tick home recheck, village lookup, attackCandidate selection with the IKnownList scan and canEntityBeSeen

members.name: decreaseAirSupply
members.note: EntityIronGolem's override keeps the air with no draw (a golem never drowns); ent-water-s1 holds one under water

members.name: collideWithEntity
members.note: an IMob it pushes against becomes its attack target when nextInt(20) == 0, before the push

members.name: onLivingUpdate
members.note: the holdRoseTick decay with the blockcrack draw, the attackTimer decay, then EntityMob's body

members.name: writeEntityToNBT
members.note: the PlayerCreated byte over the field

members.name: readEntityFromNBT
members.note: the PlayerCreated read in the replay's kind switch

members.name: attackEntityAsMob
members.note: attackTimer 10, 7 + nextInt(15) mob damage, +0.4 motionY on a hit; the S1A state 4 and the throw sound are client-side

members.name: handleHealthUpdate
members.note: client-side rose-animation response to entity state; no server state

members.name: getAttackTimer
members.note: runs only when a frame is drawn (ModelIronGolem): covframes' frame coverage runs it in its cf-cov-zoo-s1

members.name: dropFewItems
members.note: nextInt(3) poppies (38, func_145778_a at offset 0), then 3 + nextInt(3) iron ingots (265), no looting term: animal_drop_few_items' VK_IRON_GOLEM case (rare-drops-s1: a golem killed in stone)

members.name: onDeath
members.note: the -5 village reputation (iron_golem_death_village), the poppies and ingots (dropFewItems)

notes: The golem spawning side is villagers.c:v_tick (v_update_num_iron_golems with the 10-villager/10-door gate and is_valid_iron_golem_spawning_location) since world.conf built_golems = off. persist-village-s42 records a village with its golem. lane/idxentity: the golem used to drown natively (air - 1) and its navigator swam (every AI kind got canSwim); both follow EntityIronGolem now (no decreaseAirSupply draw, no EntityAISwimming): ent-water-s1. idxaudit 2026-09-27: dropped evidence that runs none of this file's code (JaCoCo): dmg-sources-s1, melee-mods-s1. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-village-full-s42, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
